tools.description: Retrieve material document line items. Filter by Material, Plant, StorageLocation, GoodsMovementType for movement analysis.

tools.name: get_a_materialdocumentitem_for_api_material_document_srv

tools.name: count_a_materialdocumentitem_for_api_material_document_srv
tools.title: count_A_MaterialDocumentItem_for_api_material_document_srv
